newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-up $0.50 -dealers.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-up $0.50 -dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Friday were seen steady to $0.50 per cwt higher, supported by continued light hog marketings, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.
Competition for tight hog supplies boosted prices during the week, they said.
However, this week's strong price advances were expected to slow on Friday as packers complete booking for Friday operations, they said.
Cash hog prices Friday also could be limited by plans for light Saturday slaughter, sources said.

Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota top prices for hogs delivered to the plant were seen unchanged at $59.00. The interior Iowa/southern Minnesota top hog price climbed $0.50 Thursday to $59.00, a $3.00 jump since last Friday.

Illinois top prices at plants were seen ranging from $59.00 to $59.50, with some plants possibly paying $60.00 for top-quality hogs, a central Illinois dealer said. Indiana/Ohio top prices at plants were seen at $59.00, sources there said.
"Some people are talking like they have what they need for Friday under their belts and others talk like they still need hogs," one dealer said.
